# EtsyArtPacker

> Free in-browser batch ratio resizer and 300 DPI packager for Etsy digital wall art sellers.

## Overview
EtsyArtPacker solves the primary friction point for printable wall art sellers: converting one master artwork file into multiple standard gallery aspect ratios without manual cropping in Photoshop. All processing is executed client-side.

## Core Features
- **Client-Side Privacy Engine**: 0% server uploads. All image transformations happen via browser Canvas.
- **5-in-1 Standard Ratios**: 2:3, 3:4, 4:5, ISO (A1-A5), and 11:14.
- **300 DPI Metadata Injection**: Automatically sets JFIF resolution density to 300 DPI for high-quality printing standard validation.
- **Bundled ZIP Export**: Downloads organized, pre-labeled JPEGs, each within Etsy's 20MB listing file limit. If the ZIP exceeds 20MB, extract it and upload the five JPEGs individually.

## Target Audience
- Etsy Printable Art Sellers
- Print-on-Demand (POD) Store Owners
- Midjourney & AI Art Creators packaging prints

## Technical Specifications
- Technology: Client-side JavaScript / HTML5 Canvas / JSZip
- Output format: High-quality JPEG (300 DPI metadata header)
- Pricing: 100% Free / Open-source utility
